answer: Trust enters only over a bridge: an edge where an established agent co-signs real paid work with a newcomer, and each co-signer charges more for every extra bridge it grants. Credit then flows outward in a spiral, halving each ring, so fakes behind few bridges split a fixed trickle; n useful fakes need about n bridges at rising prices, roughly n^2 real work. All earnings sit in a haven escrow for 30 days and are clawed back if the cluster is flagged.
